_comment: Expected identity for the North American Sonic Rush revision.
A mismatch is reported, not fatal: a European or Japanese dump parses and
disassembles identically. What differs is every absolute code address, so
annotations and symbol maps are only portable within one revision. This
file exists so that `sr report` can tell you which one you are holding
before you spend an hour naming functions that will not line up with
The checksums are deliberately absent. Filling them in would require
committing a hash of a copyrighted image, which is the first step toward
committing the image. Record your own dump's digest locally instead --
